subject: general
question: In which year did India join the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2017**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India became a full member of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) on **June 9, 2017**.
 
• The membership was granted during the **Astana Summit** held in Kazakhstan.
 
• India, along with Pakistan, became the first nations to be inducted into the SCO, which was previously a group of six countries.
 
• India's membership in the SCO was aimed at enhancing its strategic, economic, and security cooperation with the member countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO)**

 
 
• The SCO is a Eurasian political, economic, and security alliance, which was founded in 2001 in Shanghai by the leaders of China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan.
 
• The main objectives of the SCO are to strengthen mutual trust and neighborliness among the member states, promote effective cooperation in politics, trade, economy, research, technology, and culture, and work together to maintain and ensure peace, security, and stability in the region.
 
• Originally, it was called the "Shanghai Five" when it was formed in 1996, and it was renamed the SCO after Uzbekistan joined the organization in 2001.
 
• In addition to India and Pakistan, other observer states include Afghanistan, Belarus, Iran, and Mongolia, with several other countries having dialogue partner status.
 
 
 
• **Astana Summit**
 
 
• The Astana Summit refers to the SCO summit held in June 2017 in Astana, Kazakhstan.
 
• This summit was significant as it marked the expansion of the SCO with the inclusion of India and Pakistan as full members.
 
• The summit focused on discussions about regional security, economic cooperation, and cultural exchange among member states.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance of SCO Membership for India**
 
 
• Membership in the SCO provides India with a platform to engage with Central Asian countries, enhancing its strategic influence in the region.
 
• It allows India to participate in joint military exercises, contributing to regional security and counter-terrorism efforts.
 
• Economic cooperation within the SCO framework can lead to increased trade and investment opportunities for India in the Eurasian region.
 
• Being part of the SCO aligns with India's "Connect Central Asia" policy, aimed at strengthening ties with Central Asian countries.
